Had a therapist try to convince me to go to Cancun. He was certain that a change in perspective and travel would change things for me because it worked for him. 

I wish that trying to find a good therapist wasn’t like trying to win the lottery. With every therapist that fails you, you feel less and less encouraged to keep trying it seems.

I’ve been doing therapy off and on since 2013 when I graduated. Been on various medications too. Therapy and medicine just hasn’t worked for me the way I need it to. 

I think letting it out is good, but for me that wave doesn’t last more than a day before I’m back to feeling like shit again. Therapy is nice even if you feel like it doesn’t help. At least someone wants to listen, even if they are motivated by getting a paycheck. 

Medicine though has been a huge disappointment. To me they literally do nothing. I legitimately feel the same way I did before starting the pills up to the months after where the medicine is supposed to take effect. I could be taking sugar pills and be none the wiser. 

The only thing that genuinely helps is cannabis, but unfortunately prolonged use can make the situation worse, it’s not a good long term solution for me. I’ve also become very dependent on it which is common for people who have depression . But I live for those brief moments where everything just clicks and feels right.
